name: sm-keyword-refresh (CRON, SM-15 batch 1) -- BLOCKED, see meta

meta.description: AUTHORED BUT NOT RUNNABLE TODAY -- do not activate. Intended to mirror sm-rank-pull.json for the keyword-metrics (volume/difficulty/cpc) pull design doc §10 names 'sm-keyword-refresh', calling search.keywordResearch for tracked sets, cadence from tool_scope.volume.cadence. BLOCKED on a platform-side gap this ticket is not authorized to fix (platform-nest is off limits per SM-15 file ownership): modules/search/index.ts's 'search.keywordResearch' mcpTools entry has no method/pathTemplate, so mcp-hub's module-tools.ts skips it at registration ('a def with no pathTemplate is informational-only and is skipped -- not callable') -- confirmed live against the running stack 2026-07-30 (GET /mcp/tool-defs shows method:'-' path:'-' for this tool, vs. a real binding for search.pullRanks). The REAL landed route for this action is 'POST /api/:tenantId/modules/search/keyword-sets/:id/metrics-pull' (rank.ts's pullMetricsForKeywords, controller-wired, live-proven per tracker §6s) -- but it is SET-scoped, not engagement-scoped, and there is no MCP tool (real or stub) to enumerate a keyword set's id from an engagement id either. So closing this gap is a contract decision, not a one-line fix: does the real binding take {tenantId, engagementId} (mirroring pullRanks and resolving all sets under the engagement server-side, the shape this file assumes below) or {tenantId, setId} (matching the route as it exists today, needing a new list-keyword-sets tool first)? That decision belongs to whoever owns index.ts next (or the architect) -- reported, not invented, here. This file is left in the repo as the ready-to-wire shape once that lands; DO NOT import/activate it until then -- every tools/call in it will fail with 'unknown tool' (hub-side, before it ever reaches the platform).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "search.keywordResearch", arguments: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, engagementId: $json.engagementId } } }) }}
